meaning: Online money with no government backing that can change value quickly.
clues: It is a digital way to hold or send value.
It is online and can be sent over the internet.
Unlike the dollar, its value is not tied to a government or a central bank.
Its value can rise or fall quickly, and payments are often hard to reverse.
Its name starts with C and has one word.
assumes: A gift card holds a set amount of dollars to spend with one seller
A wire transfer sends dollars through a transfer service
A prepaid card holds dollars loaded before you spend them

decoys.meaning: A card you load with a set amount of money to spend at a certain store or brand.
A way to send money fast through a transfer service. Once it is sent, you usually cannot get it back.
A card loaded with money before you use it for purchases.
